annotations.title: Open sales roles by kind and employer

description: How many sales roles are open today and how many went up in the past 7 days, broken down by kind of sales role and by employer (with the slug search_sales_jobs accepts). Give a country to count only roles open to people there. Call it to size the market for salespeople, to see which employers are hiring most, or to look up an employer's slug before search_sales_jobs with platform. The roles themselves come from search_sales_jobs and the pay from get_sales_pay.

country.description: An ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code ('US', 'DE' and so on); the counts cover only roles open to people in that country.
